segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 مصطلحات اليوم

segments.src: - **WMS (Warehouse Management System):** Software that directs work inside the warehouse — receiving, putaway, slotting, picking, packing, and cycle counting.
segments.tr: - **WMS (نظام إدارة المستودعات):** برنامج يوجّه العمل داخل المستودع — الاستلام، والتخزين الأولي، وتحديد المواقع (slotting)، والالتقاط، والتعبئة، والجرد الدوري.

segments.src: - **TMS (Transportation Management System):** Software that selects carriers and modes, consolidates and tenders loads, tracks freight, and audits carrier invoices.
segments.tr: - **TMS (نظام إدارة النقل):** برنامج يختار الناقلين ووسائل النقل، ويجمّع الحمولات ويعرضها، ويتتبع الشحنات، ويدقق فواتير الناقلين.

segments.src: - **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning):** The company-wide system of record for orders, purchasing, item master data, and finance — the source WMS and TMS take direction from.
segments.tr: - **ERP (تخطيط موارد المؤسسة):** السجل الرسمي على مستوى الشركة للطلبات والمشتريات والبيانات الرئيسية للأصناف والمالية — المصدر الذي تستمد منه أنظمة WMS وTMS توجيهاتها.

segments.src: - **EDI (Electronic Data Interchange):** Standardized business documents exchanged machine-to-machine (e.g., 856 advance ship notice, 214 shipment status), still the backbone of U.S. retail supply chains.
segments.tr: - **EDI (تبادل البيانات الإلكتروني):** مستندات أعمال موحدة يتم تبادلها آلياً بين الأنظمة (مثل الرسالة 856 إشعار الشحن المسبق، والرسالة 214 حالة الشحنة)، وما زالت العمود الفقري لسلاسل التوريد للتجزئة في الولايات المتحدة.

segments.src: - **SSCC / license plate:** An 18-digit serial number in a GS1-128 barcode on a pallet or carton, letting one scan retrieve everything that unit contains.
segments.tr: - **SSCC / لوحة الترخيص:** رقم تسلسلي من 18 خانة في باركود GS1-128 على بالت أو كرتون، يتيح لمسح واحد استرجاع كل ما تحتويه هذه الوحدة.

segments.src: *Answers: **1 — B.** The WMS owns everything inside the four walls, including slotting and pick-path logic; the ERP holds the order, not the bin location.
segments.tr: *الإجابات: **1 — B.** يملك WMS كل ما هو داخل جدران المستودع الأربعة، بما في ذلك منطق التخزين الأولي وتحديد المواقع ومسار الالتقاط؛ أما ERP فيحتفظ بالطلب، لا بموقع الرف.

segments.src: **2 — False.** RFID tags cost more than a printed barcode; the real advantage is bulk, no-line-of-sight reading — hundreds of tags at once, through packaging.
segments.tr: **2 — خطأ.** تكلّف علامات RFID أكثر من الباركود المطبوع؛ والميزة الحقيقية هي القراءة بالجملة دون الحاجة إلى خط رؤية — مئات العلامات دفعة واحدة، من خلال التغليف.

segments.src: **3 — B.** Freight audit and pay is a core TMS function, and recovering billing errors is often how a TMS pays for itself.*
segments.tr: **3 — B.** تدقيق الشحن والدفع وظيفة أساسية في TMS، وغالباً ما يُسترد ثمن TMS من خلال استعادة أخطاء الفوترة.*

fr.title: [Logistics 101 #13] Votre colis fait deux trajets. Ses données en font cinquante.

segments.src: > Warehouses and trucks move boxes, but software decides which box, which truck, and when — and that software is really three systems (WMS, TMS, ERP) stitched together by scans.
segments.tr: > Les entrepôts et les camions déplacent des cartons, mais c'est le logiciel qui décide quel carton, quel camion et quand — et ce logiciel est en réalité constitué de trois systèmes (WMS, TMS, ERP) reliés entre eux par des scans.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Concept du jour

segments.src: Picture the last thing you ordered online.
segments.tr: Pensez à la dernière commande que vous avez passée en ligne.

segments.src: Physically, it made maybe four moves: shelf to tote, tote to box, box to trailer, trailer to your porch.
segments.tr: Physiquement, elle a effectué peut-être quatre déplacements : de l'étagère au bac, du bac au carton, du carton à la remorque, et de la remorque à votre porche.

segments.src: Digitally, it triggered dozens of transactions — an order record, an inventory allocation, a pick task, a carton label, a rate quote, a load tender, six or seven tracking scans, an invoice.
segments.tr: Numériquement, elle a déclenché des dizaines de transactions — un enregistrement de commande, une allocation de stock, une tâche de prélèvement, une étiquette de carton, un devis tarifaire, une offre de chargement, six ou sept scans de suivi, une facture.

segments.src: That digital layer is the **logistics information system**, and in most companies it's not one product.
segments.tr: Cette couche numérique constitue le **système d'information logistique**, et dans la plupart des entreprises, il ne s'agit pas d'un seul produit.

segments.src: It's three, each with its own job:
segments.tr: Il y en a trois, chacun avec son propre rôle :

segments.src: **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning)** is the system of record — the company's books.
segments.tr: **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning, progiciel de gestion intégré)** est le système de référence — les livres comptables de l'entreprise.

segments.src: It holds the customer order, the purchase order, the item master, the price, the general ledger.
segments.tr: Il contient la commande client, le bon de commande, la fiche article, le prix, le grand livre.

segments.src: SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics.
segments.tr: SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics.

segments.src: The ERP knows *what* was promised to whom, but it has almost no idea where any physical carton is sitting right now.
segments.tr: L'ERP sait *ce qui a été promis à qui*, mais il ne sait presque rien de l'endroit où se trouve physiquement un carton à un instant donné.

segments.src: **WMS (Warehouse Management System)** runs everything inside the four walls.
segments.tr: **WMS (Warehouse Management System, système de gestion d'entrepôt)** gère tout ce qui se passe entre les quatre murs.

segments.src: It directs receiving, decides where to putaway a pallet (slotting), generates pick tasks in an efficient walk path, controls packing and cartonization, manages cycle counts, and produces the shipping label.
segments.tr: Il dirige la réception, décide où ranger une palette (slotting), génère des tâches de prélèvement selon un parcours optimisé, pilote l'emballage et la mise en cartons, gère les inventaires tournants et produit l'étiquette d'expédition.

segments.src: Manhattan Associates, Blue Yonder, Körber.
segments.tr: Manhattan Associates, Blue Yonder, Körber.

segments.src: The WMS is the only system that truly knows that SKU 44821 is in aisle 12, bin B, quantity 63.
segments.tr: Le WMS est le seul système qui sache réellement que l'article SKU 44821 se trouve dans l'allée 12, casier B, en quantité 63.

segments.src: **TMS (Transportation Management System)** takes over once freight leaves the dock — and often before.
segments.tr: **TMS (Transportation Management System, système de gestion du transport)** prend le relais dès que le fret quitte le quai — et souvent avant.

segments.src: It rates and compares carriers, picks the mode (parcel, LTL, truckload, intermodal), consolidates small orders into one load, tenders that load to a carrier, tracks it, and audits the freight bill against the contracted rate.
segments.tr: Il évalue et compare les transporteurs, choisit le mode (colis, LTL, camion complet, intermodal), regroupe les petites commandes en un seul chargement, confie ce chargement à un transporteur, en assure le suivi et contrôle la facture de transport par rapport au tarif contractuel.

segments.src: Overpaying carriers is shockingly common without one; freight audit alone often pays for the software.
segments.tr: Payer trop cher les transporteurs est très courant sans un tel outil ; le seul audit de fret rembourse souvent le logiciel.

segments.src: The hard part isn't any single system.
segments.tr: La partie difficile n'est pas un système en particulier.

segments.src: It's **the seams**.
segments.tr: Ce sont **les jointures**.

segments.src: In the U.S., those seams are usually crossed one of two ways: **EDI**, the decades-old transaction-set standard (a 940 tells the warehouse to ship, a 945 confirms it shipped, a 204 tenders a load to a trucker, a 214 sends status updates back, an 856 is the advance ship notice that tells the retailer what's on the truck), or modern **APIs**, which do the same thing in near real time.
segments.tr: Aux États-Unis, ces jointures sont généralement franchies de deux façons : **EDI**, la norme d'ensembles de transactions vieille de plusieurs décennies (un 940 demande à l'entrepôt d'expédier, un 945 confirme l'expédition, un 204 confie un chargement à un transporteur, un 214 renvoie les mises à jour de statut, un 856 est l'avis d'expédition anticipé qui indique au distributeur ce qui se trouve dans le camion), ou les **API** modernes, qui font la même chose en quasi temps réel.

segments.src: A retail vendor who mis-formats an 856 gets a chargeback, not an email.
segments.tr: Un fournisseur de la distribution qui formate mal un 856 reçoit une retenue sur facture, pas un simple e-mail.

segments.src: And all of it runs on one humble input: **the scan**.
segments.tr: Et tout cela repose sur une seule donnée de base : **le scan**.

segments.src: Order (ERP) -> allocate -> pick & pack (WMS) -> label -> tender (TMS)
segments.tr: Order (ERP) -> allocate -> pick & pack (WMS) -> label -> tender (TMS)

segments.src: -> carrier scans -> status back to ERP -> invoice -> freight audit
segments.tr: -> carrier scans -> status back to ERP -> invoice -> freight audit

segments.src: **Barcodes** are the workhorse.
segments.tr: **Les codes-barres** sont le cheval de trait.

segments.src: A UPC identifies the product; a GS1-128 label on a pallet carries an SSCC — an 18-digit serial number that acts as a "license plate" so one scan pulls up the entire contents of that pallet.
segments.tr: Un UPC identifie le produit ; une étiquette GS1-128 apposée sur une palette porte un SSCC — un numéro de série à 18 chiffres qui fait office de « plaque d'immatriculation » : un seul scan permet d'afficher tout le contenu de cette palette.

segments.src: Barcodes are effectively free to print, but they need line of sight and one read at a time.
segments.tr: Les codes-barres sont pratiquement gratuits à imprimer, mais ils exigent une ligne de visée et ne se lisent qu'un par un.

segments.src: **RFID** (in retail supply chains, usually passive UHF "RAIN" RFID) flips that.
segments.tr: **La RFID** (dans les chaînes d'approvisionnement de la distribution, généralement la RFID UHF passive « RAIN ») change la donne.

segments.src: A reader can pick up hundreds of tags at once, through a cardboard box, without anyone aiming anything.
segments.tr: Un lecteur peut capter des centaines d'étiquettes à la fois, à travers un carton, sans que personne ait besoin de viser quoi que ce soit.

segments.src: Walk a handheld down a store aisle and count the inventory in minutes instead of hours.
segments.tr: Il suffit de parcourir un rayon avec un terminal portatif pour compter le stock en quelques minutes au lieu de quelques heures.

segments.src: The tradeoff is cost and physics: tags cost a few cents each at volume rather than nothing, and radio waves behave badly around metal and liquid.
segments.tr: Le compromis porte sur le coût et la physique : en volume, une étiquette coûte quelques centimes au lieu de rien, et les ondes radio se comportent mal à proximité du métal et des liquides.

segments.src: That's why RFID took off first in apparel — light, non-metallic, high SKU count, and painful to count by hand — and why Walmart's expansion of its RFID tagging requirements beyond apparel starting in 2022 pushed a lot of suppliers into it.
segments.tr: C'est pourquoi la RFID s'est imposée d'abord dans l'habillement — produits légers, non métalliques, très grand nombre de références et comptage manuel pénible — et pourquoi l'extension, à partir de 2022, des exigences de marquage RFID de Walmart au-delà de l'habillement a poussé beaucoup de fournisseurs à s'y mettre.

segments.src: The unglamorous truth: none of this fixes bad data.
segments.tr: La vérité peu glamour : rien de tout cela ne corrige de mauvaises données.

segments.src: If a receiver scans a pallet into the wrong bin, the WMS confidently tells a picker to walk to an empty shelf.
segments.tr: Si un réceptionnaire scanne une palette dans le mauvais casier, le WMS indique avec assurance à un préparateur d'aller vers une étagère vide.

segments.src: Garbage in, expensive walk out.
segments.tr: Des données erronées en entrée, une marche coûteuse en sortie.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dans la vie de tous les jours

segments.src: It's 11 p.m.
segments.tr: Il est 23 h

segments.src: in Columbus, Ohio, and you order a $110 pair of running shoes with free two-day shipping.
segments.tr: à Columbus, dans l'Ohio, et vous commandez une paire de chaussures de running à 110 $ avec livraison gratuite en deux jours.

segments.src: The retailer's **ERP** captures the order and the payment.
segments.tr: L'**ERP** du distributeur enregistre la commande et le paiement.

segments.src: Available-to-promise logic checks inventory and assigns it to a fulfillment center in Indiana rather than the one in Nevada — closer to you, cheaper to ship, and the shoes are actually there.
segments.tr: La logique de disponibilité promise (available-to-promise) vérifie le stock et l'affecte au centre de distribution de l'Indiana plutôt qu'à celui du Nevada — plus proche de vous, moins cher à expédier, et les chaussures y sont réellement disponibles.

segments.src: The **WMS** drops a pick task onto a handheld.
segments.tr: Le **WMS** envoie une tâche de prélèvement sur un terminal portatif.

segments.src: A picker walks a route the system optimized, scans the shelf barcode (confirming the right location), scans the shoe box (confirming the right SKU), and drops it in a tote.
segments.tr: Un préparateur suit un itinéraire optimisé par le système, scanne le code-barres de l'étagère (pour confirmer le bon emplacement), scanne la boîte de chaussures (pour confirmer le bon SKU) et la place dans un bac.

segments.src: Packing scans it again into a carton and prints a label.
segments.tr: L'emballage la scanne à nouveau, la range dans un carton et imprime une étiquette.

segments.src: Every one of those scans is the system asking "prove it" — that's how inventory records stay honest.
segments.tr: Chacun de ces scans est le système qui demande « prouve-le » — c'est ainsi que les enregistrements de stock restent fiables.

segments.src: The **TMS** — or the parcel-rating engine that plays its role — compares carriers and service levels for that ZIP code, picks one, and transmits the shipment data before the box is even on the trailer.
segments.tr: Le **TMS** — ou le moteur de tarification colis qui joue ce rôle — compare les transporteurs et les niveaux de service pour ce code postal, en choisit un, et transmet les données d'expédition avant même que le carton soit monté dans la remorque.

segments.src: That's why your tracking number goes live with "label created" while the box is still sitting in Indiana.
segments.tr: C'est pourquoi votre numéro de suivi passe à « étiquette créée » alors que le carton se trouve encore dans l'Indiana.

segments.src: Overnight the trailer runs to a sort hub — Memphis, Louisville, wherever the network routes it.
segments.tr: Pendant la nuit, la remorque rejoint un hub de tri — Memphis, Louisville, ou tout autre point que le réseau choisit.

segments.src: Each scan there is a status message flowing back upstream, which is what refreshes the tracking page you check at breakfast.
segments.tr: Chaque scan effectué là-bas génère un message de statut remontant en amont, ce qui actualise la page de suivi que vous consultez au petit-déjeuner.

segments.src: Two days later it's on your porch.
segments.tr: Deux jours plus tard, le colis est sur votre porche.

segments.src: You saw six tracking updates.
segments.tr: Vous avez vu six mises à jour de suivi.

segments.src: The systems exchanged roughly fifty messages, and any one of them going quiet is what turns "out for delivery" into a support ticket.
segments.tr: Les systèmes ont échangé une cinquantaine de messages, et si l'un d'eux se tait, « en cours de livraison » devient un ticket au support.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Récapitulatif en trois lignes

segments.src: 1. Logistics runs on three cooperating systems: ERP (the order and the books), WMS (inside the warehouse), TMS (freight and carriers).
segments.tr: 1. La logistique repose sur trois systèmes coopérants : ERP (la commande et la comptabilité), WMS (à l'intérieur de l'entrepôt), TMS (fret et transporteurs).

segments.src: 2. They talk through EDI transaction sets or APIs, and the integration seams — not the individual systems — are where most projects fail.
segments.tr: 2. Ils communiquent par des ensembles de transactions EDI ou par des API, et ce sont les jointures d'intégration — et non les systèmes pris isolément — qui font échouer la plupart des projets.

segments.src: 3. Barcodes and RFID are the data-capture layer; without accurate scans, every system downstream is confidently wrong.
segments.tr: 3. Les codes-barres et la RFID constituent la couche de capture des données ; sans scans précis, chaque système en aval se trompe avec assurance.

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Termes du jour

segments.src: - **WMS (Warehouse Management System):** Software that directs work inside the warehouse — receiving, putaway, slotting, picking, packing, and cycle counting.
segments.tr: - **WMS (Warehouse Management System) :** Logiciel qui dirige le travail à l'intérieur de l'entrepôt — réception, rangement, slotting, prélèvement, emballage et comptage cyclique.

segments.src: - **TMS (Transportation Management System):** Software that selects carriers and modes, consolidates and tenders loads, tracks freight, and audits carrier invoices.
segments.tr: - **TMS (Transportation Management System) :** Logiciel qui sélectionne les transporteurs et les modes, regroupe et confie les chargements, suit le fret et audite les factures des transporteurs.

segments.src: - **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning):** The company-wide system of record for orders, purchasing, item master data, and finance — the source WMS and TMS take direction from.
segments.tr: - **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) :** Système de référence à l'échelle de l'entreprise pour les commandes, les achats, les données de référence articles et la finance — la source dont le WMS et le TMS reçoivent leurs instructions.

segments.src: - **EDI (Electronic Data Interchange):** Standardized business documents exchanged machine-to-machine (e.g., 856 advance ship notice, 214 shipment status), still the backbone of U.S. retail supply chains.
segments.tr: - **EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) :** Documents commerciaux normalisés échangés de machine à machine (par ex. avis d'expédition anticipé 856, statut d'expédition 214), qui restent la colonne vertébrale des chaînes d'approvisionnement de la distribution américaine.

segments.src: - **SSCC / license plate:** An 18-digit serial number in a GS1-128 barcode on a pallet or carton, letting one scan retrieve everything that unit contains.
segments.tr: - **SSCC / plaque d'immatriculation :** Numéro de série à 18 chiffres inscrit dans un code-barres GS1-128 sur une palette ou un carton, permettant à un seul scan de retrouver tout ce que cette unité contient.

segments.src: *Answers: **1 — B.** The WMS owns everything inside the four walls, including slotting and pick-path logic; the ERP holds the order, not the bin location.
segments.tr: *Réponses : **1 — B.** Le WMS gère tout ce qui se trouve entre les quatre murs, y compris le slotting et la logique des parcours de prélèvement ; l'ERP contient la commande, non l'emplacement du casier.

segments.src: **2 — False.** RFID tags cost more than a printed barcode; the real advantage is bulk, no-line-of-sight reading — hundreds of tags at once, through packaging.
segments.tr: **2 — Faux.** Une étiquette RFID coûte plus cher qu'un code-barres imprimé ; le véritable avantage réside dans la lecture en masse, sans ligne de visée — des centaines d'étiquettes à la fois, à travers l'emballage.

segments.src: **3 — B.** Freight audit and pay is a core TMS function, and recovering billing errors is often how a TMS pays for itself.*
segments.tr: **3 — B.** L'audit et le paiement du fret sont une fonction centrale du TMS, et la récupération des erreurs de facturation est souvent ce qui rembourse le TMS.*

pt.title: [Logistics 101 #13] Seu pacote se move duas vezes. Os dados dele se movem cinquenta vezes.

segments.src: > Warehouses and trucks move boxes, but software decides which box, which truck, and when — and that software is really three systems (WMS, TMS, ERP) stitched together by scans.
segments.tr: > Armazéns e caminhões movem caixas, mas é o software que decide qual caixa, qual caminhão e quando, e esse software são, na verdade, três sistemas (WMS, TMS, ERP) costurados por leituras de código de barras.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Conceito de hoje

segments.src: Picture the last thing you ordered online.
segments.tr: Imagine a última coisa que você comprou online.

segments.src: Physically, it made maybe four moves: shelf to tote, tote to box, box to trailer, trailer to your porch.
segments.tr: Fisicamente, ela fez talvez quatro movimentos: da prateleira para a caixa de separação, da caixa de separação para a embalagem, da embalagem para o caminhão e do caminhão para a sua porta.

segments.src: Digitally, it triggered dozens of transactions — an order record, an inventory allocation, a pick task, a carton label, a rate quote, a load tender, six or seven tracking scans, an invoice.
segments.tr: Digitalmente, disparou dezenas de transações: um registro do pedido, uma alocação de estoque, uma tarefa de separação, uma etiqueta da caixa, uma cotação de frete, uma oferta de carga para a transportadora, seis ou sete leituras de rastreamento e uma fatura.

segments.src: That digital layer is the **logistics information system**, and in most companies it's not one product.
segments.tr: Essa camada digital é o **sistema de informação logística**, e na maioria das empresas ele não é um produto só.

segments.src: It's three, each with its own job:
segments.tr: São três, cada um com sua função:

segments.src: **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning)** is the system of record — the company's books.
segments.tr: **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning)** é o sistema de registro, os livros da empresa.

segments.src: It holds the customer order, the purchase order, the item master, the price, the general ledger.
segments.tr: Ele guarda o pedido do cliente, o pedido de compra, o cadastro de itens, o preço e o razão contábil.

segments.src: SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics.
segments.tr: SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics.

segments.src: The ERP knows *what* was promised to whom, but it has almost no idea where any physical carton is sitting right now.
segments.tr: O ERP sabe *o que* foi prometido a quem, mas quase não sabe onde está nenhuma caixa física neste momento.

segments.src: **WMS (Warehouse Management System)** runs everything inside the four walls.
segments.tr: **WMS (Warehouse Management System)** controla tudo dentro das quatro paredes.

segments.src: It directs receiving, decides where to putaway a pallet (slotting), generates pick tasks in an efficient walk path, controls packing and cartonization, manages cycle counts, and produces the shipping label.
segments.tr: Ele direciona o recebimento, decide onde armazenar um palete (slotting), gera tarefas de separação com um percurso eficiente, controla a embalagem e o encaixotamento, gerencia as contagens cíclicas e emite a etiqueta de envio.

segments.src: Manhattan Associates, Blue Yonder, Körber.
segments.tr: Manhattan Associates, Blue Yonder, Körber.

segments.src: The WMS is the only system that truly knows that SKU 44821 is in aisle 12, bin B, quantity 63.
segments.tr: O WMS é o único sistema que realmente sabe que o SKU 44821 está no corredor 12, posição B, quantidade 63.

segments.src: **TMS (Transportation Management System)** takes over once freight leaves the dock — and often before.
segments.tr: **TMS (Transportation Management System)** assume quando a carga deixa a doca, e muitas vezes antes disso.

segments.src: It rates and compares carriers, picks the mode (parcel, LTL, truckload, intermodal), consolidates small orders into one load, tenders that load to a carrier, tracks it, and audits the freight bill against the contracted rate.
segments.tr: Ele avalia e compara transportadoras, escolhe o modal (encomenda, LTL, carga fechada, intermodal), consolida pequenos pedidos em uma só carga, oferece essa carga a uma transportadora, acompanha o transporte e audita a fatura de frete contra a tarifa contratada.

segments.src: Overpaying carriers is shockingly common without one; freight audit alone often pays for the software.
segments.tr: Pagar a mais às transportadoras é surpreendentemente comum sem um TMS; a auditoria de frete sozinha muitas vezes paga o software.

segments.src: The hard part isn't any single system.
segments.tr: A parte difícil não é nenhum sistema isoladamente.

segments.src: It's **the seams**.
segments.tr: São **as junções**.

segments.src: In the U.S., those seams are usually crossed one of two ways: **EDI**, the decades-old transaction-set standard (a 940 tells the warehouse to ship, a 945 confirms it shipped, a 204 tenders a load to a trucker, a 214 sends status updates back, an 856 is the advance ship notice that tells the retailer what's on the truck), or modern **APIs**, which do the same thing in near real time.
segments.tr: Nos EUA, essas junções costumam ser atravessadas de um de dois jeitos: **EDI**, o padrão de conjuntos de transações com décadas de uso (um 940 instrui o armazém a expedir, um 945 confirma a expedição, um 204 oferece uma carga a um transportador rodoviário, um 214 envia de volta as atualizações de status e um 856 é o aviso prévio de expedição (ASN) que informa ao varejista o que está no caminhão), ou **APIs** modernas, que fazem o mesmo em tempo quase real.

segments.src: A retail vendor who mis-formats an 856 gets a chargeback, not an email.
segments.tr: Um fornecedor de varejo que formata mal um 856 recebe um estorno, não um e-mail.

segments.src: And all of it runs on one humble input: **the scan**.
segments.tr: E tudo isso roda sobre uma entrada simples: **a leitura**.

segments.tr: - **WMS (Warehouse Management System):** Software que direciona o trabalho dentro do armazém: recebimento, armazenagem (putaway), slotting, separação, embalagem e contagem cíclica.

segments.src: - **TMS (Transportation Management System):** Software that selects carriers and modes, consolidates and tenders loads, tracks freight, and audits carrier invoices.
segments.tr: - **TMS (Transportation Management System):** Software que seleciona transportadoras e modais, consolida e oferece cargas, acompanha fretes e audita faturas de transportadoras.

segments.src: - **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning):** The company-wide system of record for orders, purchasing, item master data, and finance — the source WMS and TMS take direction from.
segments.tr: - **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning):** O sistema de registro de toda a empresa para pedidos, compras, dados mestres de itens e finanças, a fonte de onde WMS e TMS recebem instruções.

in.title: [Logistics 101 #13] Paket Anda Berpindah Dua Kali. Datanya Berpindah Lima Puluh Kali.

segments.src: > Warehouses and trucks move boxes, but software decides which box, which truck, and when — and that software is really three systems (WMS, TMS, ERP) stitched together by scans.
segments.tr: > Gudang dan truk memindahkan kotak, tetapi perangkat lunaklah yang memutuskan kotak mana, truk mana, dan kapan — dan perangkat lunak itu sebenarnya terdiri dari tiga sistem (WMS, TMS, ERP) yang disatukan oleh pemindaian.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Konsep Hari Ini

segments.src: Picture the last thing you ordered online.
segments.tr: Bayangkan barang terakhir yang Anda pesan secara daring.

segments.src: Physically, it made maybe four moves: shelf to tote, tote to box, box to trailer, trailer to your porch.
segments.tr: Secara fisik, barang itu mungkin mengalami sekitar empat perpindahan: dari rak ke keranjang, dari keranjang ke kardus, dari kardus ke trailer, dari trailer ke teras rumah Anda.

segments.src: Digitally, it triggered dozens of transactions — an order record, an inventory allocation, a pick task, a carton label, a rate quote, a load tender, six or seven tracking scans, an invoice.
segments.tr: Secara digital, pesanan itu memicu puluhan transaksi — catatan pesanan, alokasi inventaris, tugas pengambilan, label karton, penawaran tarif, penawaran muatan, enam atau tujuh pemindaian pelacakan, dan sebuah faktur.

segments.src: That digital layer is the **logistics information system**, and in most companies it's not one product.
segments.tr: Lapisan digital itu adalah **sistem informasi logistik**, dan di kebanyakan perusahaan, sistem ini bukan satu produk.

segments.src: It's three, each with its own job:
segments.tr: Ada tiga, masing-masing dengan tugasnya sendiri:

segments.src: **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning)** is the system of record — the company's books.
segments.tr: **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning)** adalah sistem catatan utama — buku besar perusahaan.

segments.src: It holds the customer order, the purchase order, the item master, the price, the general ledger.
segments.tr: Sistem ini menyimpan pesanan pelanggan, pesanan pembelian, data induk barang, harga, dan buku besar umum.

segments.src: SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics.
segments.tr: SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics.

segments.src: The ERP knows *what* was promised to whom, but it has almost no idea where any physical carton is sitting right now.
segments.tr: ERP mengetahui *apa* yang dijanjikan kepada siapa, tetapi hampir tidak tahu di mana sebuah karton fisik berada saat ini.

segments.src: **WMS (Warehouse Management System)** runs everything inside the four walls.
segments.tr: **WMS (Warehouse Management System)** menjalankan semua hal di dalam dinding gudang.

segments.src: It directs receiving, decides where to putaway a pallet (slotting), generates pick tasks in an efficient walk path, controls packing and cartonization, manages cycle counts, and produces the shipping label.
segments.tr: Sistem ini mengatur penerimaan barang, memutuskan di mana menempatkan palet (slotting), membuat tugas pengambilan dengan rute jalan yang efisien, mengendalikan pengemasan dan pembentukan karton (cartonization), mengelola perhitungan siklus (cycle count), dan mencetak label pengiriman.

segments.src: Manhattan Associates, Blue Yonder, Körber.
segments.tr: Manhattan Associates, Blue Yonder, Körber.

segments.src: The WMS is the only system that truly knows that SKU 44821 is in aisle 12, bin B, quantity 63.
segments.tr: WMS adalah satu-satunya sistem yang benar-benar tahu bahwa SKU 44821 ada di lorong 12, bin B, jumlah 63.

segments.src: **TMS (Transportation Management System)** takes over once freight leaves the dock — and often before.
segments.tr: **TMS (Transportation Management System)** mengambil alih begitu barang keluar dari dok — dan sering kali bahkan sebelumnya.

segments.src: It rates and compares carriers, picks the mode (parcel, LTL, truckload, intermodal), consolidates small orders into one load, tenders that load to a carrier, tracks it, and audits the freight bill against the contracted rate.
segments.tr: Sistem ini menilai dan membandingkan vendor angkut (carrier), memilih moda (paket, LTL, truk muatan penuh, intermodal), menggabungkan pesanan kecil menjadi satu muatan, menawarkan muatan itu kepada vendor angkut, melacaknya, dan mengaudit tagihan angkutan terhadap tarif kontrak.

segments.src: Overpaying carriers is shockingly common without one; freight audit alone often pays for the software.
segments.tr: Membayar kelebihan kepada vendor angkut sangat umum tanpa sistem ini; audit angkutan saja sering kali sudah menutupi biaya perangkat lunaknya.

segments.src: The hard part isn't any single system.
segments.tr: Bagian yang sulit bukanlah sistem tunggal mana pun.

segments.src: It's **the seams**.
segments.tr: Melainkan **sambungan antarsistem**.

segments.src: In the U.S., those seams are usually crossed one of two ways: **EDI**, the decades-old transaction-set standard (a 940 tells the warehouse to ship, a 945 confirms it shipped, a 204 tenders a load to a trucker, a 214 sends status updates back, an 856 is the advance ship notice that tells the retailer what's on the truck), or modern **APIs**, which do the same thing in near real time.
segments.tr: Di AS, sambungan ini biasanya dilintasi dengan dua cara: **EDI**, standar set transaksi yang sudah berpuluh-puluh tahun (940 memberi tahu gudang untuk mengirim, 945 mengonfirmasi bahwa barang sudah dikirim, 204 menawarkan muatan kepada pengangkut, 214 mengirim pembaruan status kembali, 856 adalah advance ship notice yang memberi tahu peritel apa yang ada di truk), atau **API** modern, yang melakukan hal yang sama hampir secara real time.

segments.src: A retail vendor who mis-formats an 856 gets a chargeback, not an email.
segments.tr: Vendor ritel yang salah memformat 856 akan mendapat chargeback, bukan sekadar email.

segments.src: And all of it runs on one humble input: **the scan**.
segments.tr: Dan semua ini berjalan dengan satu masukan sederhana: **pemindaian**.

segments.src: Order (ERP) -> allocate -> pick & pack (WMS) -> label -> tender (TMS)
segments.tr: Order (ERP) -> allocate -> pick & pack (WMS) -> label -> tender (TMS)

segments.src: -> carrier scans -> status back to ERP -> invoice -> freight audit
segments.tr: -> carrier scans -> status back to ERP -> invoice -> freight audit

segments.src: **Barcodes** are the workhorse.
segments.tr: **Barcode** adalah kuda pekerja utamanya.

segments.src: A UPC identifies the product; a GS1-128 label on a pallet carries an SSCC — an 18-digit serial number that acts as a "license plate" so one scan pulls up the entire contents of that pallet.
segments.tr: UPC mengidentifikasi produk; label GS1-128 pada palet membawa SSCC — nomor seri 18 digit yang berfungsi sebagai "nomor plat" sehingga satu pemindaian menampilkan seluruh isi palet tersebut.

segments.src: Barcodes are effectively free to print, but they need line of sight and one read at a time.
segments.tr: Barcode praktis murah untuk dicetak, tetapi membutuhkan garis pandang dan pembacaan satu per satu.

segments.src: **RFID** (in retail supply chains, usually passive UHF "RAIN" RFID) flips that.
segments.tr: **RFID** (dalam rantai pasok ritel, biasanya RFID UHF pasif "RAIN") membalik hal itu.

segments.src: A reader can pick up hundreds of tags at once, through a cardboard box, without anyone aiming anything.
segments.tr: Pembaca dapat menangkap ratusan tag sekaligus, menembus kardus, tanpa seorang pun perlu mengarahkannya.

segments.src: Walk a handheld down a store aisle and count the inventory in minutes instead of hours.
segments.tr: Bawa perangkat genggam menyusuri lorong toko dan hitung inventaris dalam hitungan menit, bukan jam.

segments.src: The tradeoff is cost and physics: tags cost a few cents each at volume rather than nothing, and radio waves behave badly around metal and liquid.
segments.tr: Komprominya adalah biaya dan fisika: tag berharga beberapa sen masing-masing dalam volume besar, dan gelombang radio berperilaku buruk di dekat logam dan cairan.

segments.src: That's why RFID took off first in apparel — light, non-metallic, high SKU count, and painful to count by hand — and why Walmart's expansion of its RFID tagging requirements beyond apparel starting in 2022 pushed a lot of suppliers into it.
segments.tr: Itulah sebabnya RFID pertama kali berkembang di industri pakaian — ringan, nonlogam, jumlah SKU tinggi, dan sulit dihitung manual — dan mengapa perluasan persyaratan pemasangan tag RFID Walmart di luar pakaian mulai 2022 mendorong banyak pemasok untuk menggunakannya.

segments.src: The unglamorous truth: none of this fixes bad data.
segments.tr: Kenyataan yang tidak glamor: tidak satu pun dari ini memperbaiki data yang buruk.

segments.src: If a receiver scans a pallet into the wrong bin, the WMS confidently tells a picker to walk to an empty shelf.
segments.tr: Jika penerima barang memindai palet ke bin yang salah, WMS dengan yakin memberi tahu pengambil untuk berjalan ke rak kosong.

segments.src: Garbage in, expensive walk out.
segments.tr: Masukan buruk, jalan kaki yang mahal.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari

segments.src: It's 11 p.m.
segments.tr: Sekarang pukul 23.00

segments.src: in Columbus, Ohio, and you order a $110 pair of running shoes with free two-day shipping.
segments.tr: di Columbus, Ohio, dan Anda memesan sepasang sepatu lari seharga $110 dengan pengiriman gratis dua hari.

segments.src: The retailer's **ERP** captures the order and the payment.
segments.tr: **ERP** peritel menangkap pesanan dan pembayaran.

segments.src: Available-to-promise logic checks inventory and assigns it to a fulfillment center in Indiana rather than the one in Nevada — closer to you, cheaper to ship, and the shoes are actually there.
segments.tr: Logika available-to-promise memeriksa inventaris dan menugaskannya ke pusat distribusi di Indiana, bukan yang di Nevada — lebih dekat dengan Anda, lebih murah untuk dikirim, dan sepatunya memang ada di sana.

segments.src: The **WMS** drops a pick task onto a handheld.
segments.tr: **WMS** menjatuhkan tugas pengambilan ke perangkat genggam.

segments.src: A picker walks a route the system optimized, scans the shelf barcode (confirming the right location), scans the shoe box (confirming the right SKU), and drops it in a tote.
segments.tr: Pengambil berjalan mengikuti rute yang dioptimalkan sistem, memindai barcode rak (memastikan lokasinya benar), memindai kotak sepatu (memastikan SKU-nya benar), lalu memasukkannya ke keranjang.

segments.src: Packing scans it again into a carton and prints a label.
segments.tr: Pengemasan memindainya lagi ke dalam karton dan mencetak label.

segments.src: Every one of those scans is the system asking "prove it" — that's how inventory records stay honest.
segments.tr: Setiap pemindaian itu adalah sistem yang bertanya "buktikan" — begitulah catatan inventaris tetap jujur.

segments.src: The **TMS** — or the parcel-rating engine that plays its role — compares carriers and service levels for that ZIP code, picks one, and transmits the shipment data before the box is even on the trailer.
segments.tr: **TMS** — atau mesin penilaian paket yang menjalankan perannya — membandingkan vendor angkut dan tingkat layanan untuk kode pos tersebut, memilih salah satu, dan mengirimkan data pengiriman sebelum kotak bahkan berada di trailer.

segments.src: That's why your tracking number goes live with "label created" while the box is still sitting in Indiana.
segments.tr: Itulah sebabnya nomor pelacakan Anda aktif dengan status "label dibuat" saat kotak masih berada di Indiana.

segments.src: Overnight the trailer runs to a sort hub — Memphis, Louisville, wherever the network routes it.
segments.tr: Semalaman trailer berjalan ke hub penyortiran — Memphis, Louisville, mana pun yang dirutekan jaringan.

segments.src: Each scan there is a status message flowing back upstream, which is what refreshes the tracking page you check at breakfast.
segments.tr: Setiap pemindaian di sana adalah pesan status yang mengalir kembali ke hulu, yang menyegarkan halaman pelacakan yang Anda cek saat sarapan.

segments.src: Two days later it's on your porch.
segments.tr: Dua hari kemudian barang sampai di teras Anda.

segments.src: You saw six tracking updates.
segments.tr: Anda melihat enam pembaruan pelacakan.

segments.src: The systems exchanged roughly fifty messages, and any one of them going quiet is what turns "out for delivery" into a support ticket.
segments.tr: Sistem-sistem tersebut bertukar sekitar lima puluh pesan, dan jika salah satunya terhenti, itulah yang mengubah "sedang diantar" menjadi tiket dukungan.

segments.src: > Warehouses and trucks move boxes, but software decides which box, which truck, and when — and that software is really three systems (WMS, TMS, ERP) stitched together by scans.
segments.tr: > 倉庫やトラックは荷物を動かしますが、どの箱をどのトラックに、いつ動かすかを決めるのはソフトウェアです。そしてそのソフトウェアは実際には3つのシステム(WMS、TMS、ERP)がスキャンでつなぎ合わされたものです。

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 今日のコンセプト

segments.src: Picture the last thing you ordered online.
segments.tr: 最後にオンラインで注文した品物を思い浮かべてください。

segments.src: Physically, it made maybe four moves: shelf to tote, tote to box, box to trailer, trailer to your porch.
segments.tr: 物理的には、おそらく4回の移動がありました。棚からトート(かご)へ、トートから箱へ、箱からトレーラーへ、トレーラーからあなたの玄関先へ。

segments.src: Digitally, it triggered dozens of transactions — an order record, an inventory allocation, a pick task, a carton label, a rate quote, a load tender, six or seven tracking scans, an invoice.
segments.tr: デジタル上では、数十件のトランザクションが発生しました。注文記録、在庫の引当、ピッキング作業、カートンラベル、運賃見積もり、積載の手配、6〜7回の追跡スキャン、請求書。

segments.src: That digital layer is the **logistics information system**, and in most companies it's not one product.
segments.tr: そのデジタル層が**物流情報システム**であり、ほとんどの企業ではそれは1つの製品ではありません。

segments.src: It's three, each with its own job:
segments.tr: それは3つで、それぞれ固有の役割を持っています:

segments.src: **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning)** is the system of record — the company's books.
segments.tr: **ERP(Enterprise Resource Planning、基幹業務システム)**は、記録の正本(system of record)、つまり企業の帳簿です。

segments.src: It holds the customer order, the purchase order, the item master, the price, the general ledger.
segments.tr: 顧客注文、発注書、品目マスタ、価格、総勘定元帳を保持しています。

segments.src: SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics.
segments.tr: SAP、Oracle、NetSuite、Microsoft Dynamics。

segments.src: The ERP knows *what* was promised to whom, but it has almost no idea where any physical carton is sitting right now.
segments.tr: ERPは*何が誰に約束されたか*を把握していますが、今まさにどのカートンがどこにあるかはほとんど分かりません。

segments.src: **WMS (Warehouse Management System)** runs everything inside the four walls.
segments.tr: **WMS(Warehouse Management System、倉庫管理システム)**は、壁の内側のすべてを動かします。

segments.src: It directs receiving, decides where to putaway a pallet (slotting), generates pick tasks in an efficient walk path, controls packing and cartonization, manages cycle counts, and produces the shipping label.
segments.tr: 入荷を指示し、パレットの格納場所(putaway、スロッティング)を決め、効率的な歩行経路でピッキング作業を生成し、梱包とカートン化を管理し、サイクルカウントを管理し、出荷ラベルを発行します。

segments.src: Manhattan Associates, Blue Yonder, Körber.
segments.tr: Manhattan Associates、Blue Yonder、Körber。

segments.src: The WMS is the only system that truly knows that SKU 44821 is in aisle 12, bin B, quantity 63.
segments.tr: WMSだけが、SKU 44821が通路12のビンB、数量63であることを本当に把握しています。

segments.src: **TMS (Transportation Management System)** takes over once freight leaves the dock — and often before.
segments.tr: **TMS(Transportation Management System、輸配送管理システム)**は、貨物がドックを出た後に引き継ぎ、多くの場合はそれより前から関わります。

segments.src: It rates and compares carriers, picks the mode (parcel, LTL, truckload, intermodal), consolidates small orders into one load, tenders that load to a carrier, tracks it, and audits the freight bill against the contracted rate.
segments.tr: 運送会社の料金を見積もって比較し、輸送モード(宅配便、LTL、トラックload、複合一貫輸送)を選び、小口の注文を1つの積載にまとめ、その積載を運送会社に手配し、追跡し、運送請求書を契約運賃と照合して監査します。

segments.src: Overpaying carriers is shockingly common without one; freight audit alone often pays for the software.
segments.tr: TMSがなければ運送会社への過払いは驚くほどよく起きます。運賃監査だけでシステムの費用を回収できることも多いです。

segments.src: The hard part isn't any single system.
segments.tr: 難しいのは、どの単一のシステムかではありません。

segments.src: It's **the seams**.
segments.tr: **連携の継ぎ目(seam)**です。

segments.src: In the U.S., those seams are usually crossed one of two ways: **EDI**, the decades-old transaction-set standard (a 940 tells the warehouse to ship, a 945 confirms it shipped, a 204 tenders a load to a trucker, a 214 sends status updates back, an 856 is the advance ship notice that tells the retailer what's on the truck), or modern **APIs**, which do the same thing in near real time.
segments.tr: 米国では、その継ぎ目は通常2つの方法のどちらかで受け渡されます。1つは**EDI**で、数十年前から使われているトランザクションセットの標準です(940は倉庫に出荷を指示し、945は出荷済みを確認し、204は運送業者に積載を手配し、214はステータス更新を返し、856は出荷事前通知(ASN)で、トラックに積まれている内容を小売業者に伝えます)。もう1つは、同じことをほぼリアルタイムで行う最新の**API**です。

segments.src: A retail vendor who mis-formats an 856 gets a chargeback, not an email.
segments.tr: 856を誤った形式で送った小売ベンダーは、メールではなくチャージバック(差し戻し・減額)を受けます。

segments.src: And all of it runs on one humble input: **the scan**.
segments.tr: そして、そのすべては1つの地味な入力に依存しています:**スキャン**です。

segments.src: Order (ERP) -> allocate -> pick & pack (WMS) -> label -> tender (TMS)
segments.tr: Order (ERP) -> allocate -> pick & pack (WMS) -> label -> tender (TMS)

segments.src: -> carrier scans -> status back to ERP -> invoice -> freight audit
segments.tr: -> carrier scans -> status back to ERP -> invoice -> freight audit

segments.src: **Barcodes** are the workhorse.
segments.tr: **バーコード**が主力です。

segments.src: A UPC identifies the product; a GS1-128 label on a pallet carries an SSCC — an 18-digit serial number that acts as a "license plate" so one scan pulls up the entire contents of that pallet.
segments.tr: UPCは商品を識別します。パレットのGS1-128ラベルはSSCC(18桁のシリアル番号)を持ち、「ライセンスプレート(管理番号)」として機能するため、1回のスキャンでそのパレットの全内容を呼び出せます。

segments.src: Barcodes are effectively free to print, but they need line of sight and one read at a time.
segments.tr: バーコードは印刷コストがほぼゼロですが、視線が通っている必要があり、一度に1つずつしか読めません。

segments.src: **RFID** (in retail supply chains, usually passive UHF "RAIN" RFID) flips that.
segments.tr: **RFID**(小売サプライチェーンでは通常パッシブUHFの「RAIN」RFID)はそれを変えます。

segments.src: A reader can pick up hundreds of tags at once, through a cardboard box, without anyone aiming anything.
segments.tr: リーダーは、誰も狙いを定めなくても、段ボール箱越しに数百個のタグを一度に読み取れます。

segments.src: Walk a handheld down a store aisle and count the inventory in minutes instead of hours.
segments.tr: ハンディ端末を店舗の通路に沿って歩かせれば、数時間ではなく数分で在庫を数えられます。

segments.src: The tradeoff is cost and physics: tags cost a few cents each at volume rather than nothing, and radio waves behave badly around metal and liquid.
segments.tr: トレードオフはコストと物理特性です。タグは大量購入時でも1個数セントかかり(ゼロではない)、電波は金属や液体の近くでうまく働きません。

segments.src: That's why RFID took off first in apparel — light, non-metallic, high SKU count, and painful to count by hand — and why Walmart's expansion of its RFID tagging requirements beyond apparel starting in 2022 pushed a lot of suppliers into it.
segments.tr: そのため、RFIDはまずアパレルで普及しました。軽量で非金属、SKU数が多く、手作業での棚卸しが大変だからです。2022年以降、Walmartがアパレル以外へのRFIDタグ付け要件を拡大したことで、多くのサプライヤーがRFIDを導入することになりました。

segments.src: The unglamorous truth: none of this fixes bad data.
segments.tr: 地味ながら本当のことを言えば、これらのどれも悪いデータを直しはしません。

segments.src: If a receiver scans a pallet into the wrong bin, the WMS confidently tells a picker to walk to an empty shelf.
segments.tr: 受け入れ担当者がパレットを誤ったビンにスキャンすると、WMSはピッカーに空の棚へ歩いて行けと自信満々に指示します。

segments.src: Garbage in, expensive walk out.
segments.tr: ゴミを入れれば、高くついた無駄足が出てくる。

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 日常生活の中で

segments.src: It's 11 p.m.
segments.tr: 午後11時。

segments.src: in Columbus, Ohio, and you order a $110 pair of running shoes with free two-day shipping.
segments.tr: オハイオ州コロンバスで、無料2日配送付きの110ドルのランニングシューズを注文します。

segments.src: The retailer's **ERP** captures the order and the payment.
segments.tr: 小売業者の**ERP**が注文と支払いを記録します。

segments.src: Available-to-promise logic checks inventory and assigns it to a fulfillment center in Indiana rather than the one in Nevada — closer to you, cheaper to ship, and the shoes are actually there.
segments.tr: 販売可能数(ATP)のロジックが在庫を確認し、ネバダの物流センターではなく、インディアナの物流センターに割り当てます。あなたに近く、輸送コストが安く、靴が実際にそこにあるからです。

segments.src: The **WMS** drops a pick task onto a handheld.
segments.tr: **WMS**がピッキング作業をハンディ端末に送ります。

segments.src: A picker walks a route the system optimized, scans the shelf barcode (confirming the right location), scans the shoe box (confirming the right SKU), and drops it in a tote.
segments.tr: ピッカーはシステムが最適化した経路を歩き、棚のバーコードをスキャンし(正しいロケーションを確認)、靴箱をスキャンし(正しいSKUを確認)、かごに入れます。

segments.src: Packing scans it again into a carton and prints a label.
segments.tr: 梱包時にカートンへ入れて再度スキャンし、ラベルを印刷します。

segments.src: Every one of those scans is the system asking "prove it" — that's how inventory records stay honest.
segments.tr: これらのスキャンのひとつひとつは、システムが「証明せよ」と問いかけているのです。それによって在庫記録が正直に保たれます。

segments.src: The **TMS** — or the parcel-rating engine that plays its role — compares carriers and service levels for that ZIP code, picks one, and transmits the shipment data before the box is even on the trailer.
segments.tr: **TMS**(またはその役割を担う宅配料金計算エンジン)が、そのZIPコードに対する運送会社とサービスレベルを比較し、ひとつを選び、箱がトレーラーに積まれる前に出荷データを送信します。

segments.src: That's why your tracking number goes live with "label created" while the box is still sitting in Indiana.
segments.tr: だから、箱がまだインディアナにあるうちに、追跡番号が「ラベル作成済み」として有効になるのです。

segments.src: Overnight the trailer runs to a sort hub — Memphis, Louisville, wherever the network routes it.
segments.tr: 夜間、トレーラーはソートハブ(メンフィス、ルイビルなど、ネットワークがルーティングした場所)へ向かいます。

segments.src: Each scan there is a status message flowing back upstream, which is what refreshes the tracking page you check at breakfast.
segments.tr: そこでの各スキャンは上流へ送られるステータスメッセージであり、朝食時に見る追跡ページを更新するものです。

segments.src: Two days later it's on your porch.
segments.tr: 2日後、それはあなたの玄関先に届きます。

segments.src: You saw six tracking updates.
segments.tr: 追跡更新は6回見ました。

segments.src: The systems exchanged roughly fifty messages, and any one of them going quiet is what turns "out for delivery" into a support ticket.
segments.tr: システム同士はおよそ50件のメッセージをやり取りしており、そのどれか1つでも途絶えると、「配達に出発」がサポートチケットに変わってしまいます。

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## 3行まとめ

segments.src: 1. Logistics runs on three cooperating systems: ERP (the order and the books), WMS (inside the warehouse), TMS (freight and carriers).
segments.tr: 1. 物流は3つの協調するシステムで動きます:ERP(注文と帳簿)、WMS(倉庫内)、TMS(貨物と運送会社)。

segments.src: 2. They talk through EDI transaction sets or APIs, and the integration seams — not the individual systems — are where most projects fail.
segments.tr: 2. それらはEDIのトランザクションセットかAPIを通じてやり取りし、個々のシステムではなく連携の継ぎ目こそ、多くのプロジェクトが失敗する場所です。

segments.src: 3. Barcodes and RFID are the data-capture layer; without accurate scans, every system downstream is confidently wrong.
segments.tr: 3. バーコードとRFIDはデータ取得層であり、正確なスキャンがなければ、その下流のすべてのシステムは自信満々に間違います。

segments.src: ## ✅ Self-Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ 自己チェッククイズ

segments.src: **1.** A distribution center needs to decide which bin to store an incoming pallet in, and which pick path a worker should walk.
segments.tr: **1.** 配送センターは、入荷したパレットをどのビンに保管するか、また作業者がどのピックパスを歩くべきかを決める必要があります。

segments.src: Which system handles this?
segments.tr: どのシステムがこれを扱いますか?

segments.src: - A) ERP
segments.tr: - A) ERP

segments.src: - B) WMS
segments.tr: - B) WMS

segments.src: - C) TMS
segments.tr: - C) TMS

segments.src: - D) EDI
segments.tr: - D) EDI

segments.src: **2.** True or False: The main advantage of RFID over barcodes is that RFID tags are cheaper per unit.
segments.tr: **2.** 正誤を答えてください:RFIDがバーコードに対して持つ主な利点は、RFIDタグが単価で安いことである。

segments.src: **3.** Your company is overpaying carriers because nobody checks freight invoices against contracted rates.
segments.tr: **3.** 御社は、誰も請求書を契約運賃と照合していないため、運送会社に過払いしています。

segments.src: Which capability addresses this most directly?
segments.tr: どの機能がこれに最も直接対処しますか?

segments.src: - A) Cycle counting in the WMS
segments.tr: - A) WMSのサイクルカウント

segments.src: - B) Freight audit and pay in the TMS
segments.tr: - B) TMSの運賃監査と支払い

segments.src: - C) The item master in the ERP
segments.tr: - C) ERPの品目マスタ

segments.src: - D) SSCC license plate labels
segments.tr: - D) SSCCのライセンスプレートラベル

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 今日の用語

segments.src: - **WMS (Warehouse Management System):** Software that directs work inside the warehouse — receiving, putaway, slotting, picking, packing, and cycle counting.
segments.tr: - **WMS(Warehouse Management System、倉庫管理システム):** 入荷、格納、スロッティング、ピッキング、梱包、サイクルカウントなど、倉庫内の作業を指示するソフトウェア。

segments.src: - **TMS (Transportation Management System):** Software that selects carriers and modes, consolidates and tenders loads, tracks freight, and audits carrier invoices.
segments.tr: - **TMS(Transportation Management System、輸配送管理システム):** 運送会社とモードを選択し、積載をまとめて手配し、貨物を追跡し、運送業者の請求書を監査するソフトウェア。

segments.src: - **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning):** The company-wide system of record for orders, purchasing, item master data, and finance — the source WMS and TMS take direction from.
segments.tr: - **ERP(Enterprise Resource Planning、基幹業務システム):** 注文、購買、品目マスタデータ、財務に関する全社的な記録の正本で、WMSとTMSが指示を受ける元となるもの。

segments.src: - **EDI (Electronic Data Interchange):** Standardized business documents exchanged machine-to-machine (e.g., 856 advance ship notice, 214 shipment status), still the backbone of U.S. retail supply chains.
segments.tr: - **EDI(Electronic Data Interchange、電子データ交換):** 機械間で交換される標準化された業務文書(例:856 出荷事前通知、214 出荷ステータス)で、今も米国の小売サプライチェーンの基幹です。

segments.src: - **SSCC / license plate:** An 18-digit serial number in a GS1-128 barcode on a pallet or carton, letting one scan retrieve everything that unit contains.
segments.tr: - **SSCC / ライセンスプレート:** パレットやカートンのGS1-128バーコードに含まれる18桁のシリアル番号で、1回のスキャンでその単位が含むすべてを呼び出せるようにするもの。

segments.src: *Answers: **1 — B.** The WMS owns everything inside the four walls, including slotting and pick-path logic; the ERP holds the order, not the bin location.
segments.tr: *解答: **1 — B.** WMSはスロッティングやピックパスのロジックを含め、壁の内側のすべてを管理します。ERPは注文を保持しますが、ビンの位置は保持しません。

segments.src: **2 — False.** RFID tags cost more than a printed barcode; the real advantage is bulk, no-line-of-sight reading — hundreds of tags at once, through packaging.
segments.tr: **2 — 誤り。** RFIDタグは印刷されたバーコードより高価です。本当の利点は、視線を必要とせずに大量のタグを一度に読めることです。包装越しに数百個のタグを読み取れます。

segments.src: **3 — B.** Freight audit and pay is a core TMS function, and recovering billing errors is often how a TMS pays for itself.*
segments.tr: **3 — B.** 運賃監査と支払いはTMSのコア機能であり、請求の誤りを回収することが、TMSが自ら元を取る典型的な方法であることも多いです。*

segments.tr: Es bewertet und vergleicht Frachtführer, wählt den Verkehrsträger (Paket, LTL, Komplettladung, kombinierter Verkehr), bündelt kleine Aufträge zu einer Ladung, übergibt diese Ladung an einen Frachtführer, verfolgt sie und prüft die Frachtrechnung gegen den vereinbarten Tarif.

segments.src: Overpaying carriers is shockingly common without one; freight audit alone often pays for the software.
segments.tr: Zu viel bezahlte Frachtführer sind ohne TMS erschreckend häufig; allein die Frachtprüfung finanziert oft die Software.

segments.src: The hard part isn't any single system.
segments.tr: Das Schwierige ist nicht ein einzelnes System.

segments.src: It's **the seams**.
segments.tr: Es sind **die Schnittstellen**.

segments.src: In the U.S., those seams are usually crossed one of two ways: **EDI**, the decades-old transaction-set standard (a 940 tells the warehouse to ship, a 945 confirms it shipped, a 204 tenders a load to a trucker, a 214 sends status updates back, an 856 is the advance ship notice that tells the retailer what's on the truck), or modern **APIs**, which do the same thing in near real time.
segments.tr: In den USA werden diese Schnittstellen meist auf zwei Arten überbrückt: **EDI**, der seit Jahrzehnten bestehende Standard für Transaktionssätze (ein 940 weist das Lager an zu versenden, ein 945 bestätigt den Versand, ein 204 übergibt eine Ladung an einen Spediteur, ein 214 meldet Statusaktualisierungen zurück, ein 856 ist die Vorab-Versandanzeige, die dem Händler mitteilt, was auf dem Lkw ist), oder moderne **APIs**, die dasselbe nahezu in Echtzeit leisten.

segments.src: A retail vendor who mis-formats an 856 gets a chargeback, not an email.
segments.tr: Ein Einzelhandelslieferant, der einen 856 falsch formatiert, bekommt eine Rückbelastung, keine E-Mail.

segments.src: And all of it runs on one humble input: **the scan**.
segments.tr: Und all das läuft auf einer bescheidenen Eingabe: **dem Scan**.

segments.src: Order (ERP) -> allocate -> pick & pack (WMS) -> label -> tender (TMS)
segments.tr: Order (ERP) -> allocate -> pick & pack (WMS) -> label -> tender (TMS)

segments.src: -> carrier scans -> status back to ERP -> invoice -> freight audit
segments.tr: -> carrier scans -> status back to ERP -> invoice -> freight audit

segments.src: **Barcodes** are the workhorse.
segments.tr: **Barcodes** sind das Arbeitspferd.

segments.src: A UPC identifies the product; a GS1-128 label on a pallet carries an SSCC — an 18-digit serial number that acts as a "license plate" so one scan pulls up the entire contents of that pallet.
segments.tr: Ein UPC identifiziert das Produkt; ein GS1-128-Etikett auf einer Palette trägt eine SSCC, eine 18-stellige Seriennummer, die als „Kennzeichen“ dient, sodass ein einziger Scan den gesamten Inhalt dieser Palette abruft.

segments.src: Barcodes are effectively free to print, but they need line of sight and one read at a time.
segments.tr: Barcodes sind praktisch kostenlos zu drucken, benötigen aber Sichtverbindung und werden jeweils einzeln gelesen.

segments.src: **RFID** (in retail supply chains, usually passive UHF "RAIN" RFID) flips that.
segments.tr: **RFID** (in Einzelhandels-Lieferketten meist passives UHF-RFID nach dem Standard „RAIN“) dreht das um.

segments.src: A reader can pick up hundreds of tags at once, through a cardboard box, without anyone aiming anything.
segments.tr: Ein Lesegerät kann Hunderte Etiketten gleichzeitig erfassen, durch einen Karton hindurch, ohne dass jemand etwas anvisieren muss.

segments.src: Walk a handheld down a store aisle and count the inventory in minutes instead of hours.
segments.tr: Gehen Sie mit einem Handgerät durch einen Ladengang und zählen Sie den Bestand in Minuten statt Stunden.

segments.src: The tradeoff is cost and physics: tags cost a few cents each at volume rather than nothing, and radio waves behave badly around metal and liquid.
segments.tr: Der Kompromiss sind Kosten und Physik: Etiketten kosten bei großen Mengen einige Cent pro Stück statt nichts, und Funkwellen verhalten sich in der Nähe von Metall und Flüssigkeiten schlecht.

segments.src: That's why RFID took off first in apparel — light, non-metallic, high SKU count, and painful to count by hand — and why Walmart's expansion of its RFID tagging requirements beyond apparel starting in 2022 pushed a lot of suppliers into it.
segments.tr: Deshalb hat sich RFID zuerst in der Bekleidungsindustrie durchgesetzt, denn Kleidung ist leicht, nicht metallisch, hat eine hohe SKU-Zahl und ist mühsam von Hand zu zählen. Und die ab 2022 erfolgte Ausweitung der RFID-Kennzeichnungspflicht von Walmart über Bekleidung hinaus hat viele Lieferanten dazu gebracht, umzusteigen.

segments.src: The unglamorous truth: none of this fixes bad data.
segments.tr: Die unschöne Wahrheit: Nichts davon behebt schlechte Daten.

segments.src: If a receiver scans a pallet into the wrong bin, the WMS confidently tells a picker to walk to an empty shelf.
segments.tr: Wenn eine Wareneingangskraft eine Palette in das falsche Fach scannt, schickt das WMS einen Kommissionierer selbstbewusst zu einem leeren Regal.

segments.src: Garbage in, expensive walk out.
segments.tr: Schlechte Eingabe, teurer Umweg.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Im Alltag

segments.src: It's 11 p.m.
segments.tr: Es ist 23 Uhr

segments.src: in Columbus, Ohio, and you order a $110 pair of running shoes with free two-day shipping.
segments.tr: in Columbus, Ohio, und Sie bestellen ein Paar Laufschuhe für 110 $ mit kostenlosem Zwei-Tage-Versand.

segments.src: The retailer's **ERP** captures the order and the payment.
segments.tr: Das **ERP** des Händlers erfasst Bestellung und Zahlung.

segments.src: Available-to-promise logic checks inventory and assigns it to a fulfillment center in Indiana rather than the one in Nevada — closer to you, cheaper to ship, and the shoes are actually there.
segments.tr: Die Logik „verfügbar zum Versprechen“ prüft den Bestand und weist ihn einem Logistikzentrum in Indiana zu statt dem in Nevada: näher an Ihnen, günstiger im Versand, und die Schuhe sind tatsächlich dort.

segments.src: The **WMS** drops a pick task onto a handheld.
segments.tr: Das **WMS** legt einen Kommissionierauftrag auf ein Handgerät.

segments.src: A picker walks a route the system optimized, scans the shelf barcode (confirming the right location), scans the shoe box (confirming the right SKU), and drops it in a tote.
segments.tr: Ein Kommissionierer geht eine vom System optimierte Route, scannt den Regalbarcode (zur Bestätigung des richtigen Lagerplatzes), scannt den Schuhkarton (zur Bestätigung der richtigen SKU) und legt ihn in einen Behälter.

segments.src: Packing scans it again into a carton and prints a label.
segments.tr: Beim Verpacken wird er erneut in einen Karton gescannt und ein Etikett gedruckt.

segments.src: Every one of those scans is the system asking "prove it" — that's how inventory records stay honest.
segments.tr: Jeder dieser Scans fragt das System: „Beweis es.“ So bleiben die Bestandsdaten ehrlich.

segments.src: The **TMS** — or the parcel-rating engine that plays its role — compares carriers and service levels for that ZIP code, picks one, and transmits the shipment data before the box is even on the trailer.
segments.tr: Das **TMS** (oder die Tarifberechnungs-Engine für Paketdienste, die diese Rolle übernimmt) vergleicht Frachtführer und Servicestufen für diese PLZ, wählt einen aus und überträgt die Versanddaten, noch bevor der Karton auf dem Trailer ist.

segments.src: That's why your tracking number goes live with "label created" while the box is still sitting in Indiana.
segments.tr: Deshalb wird Ihre Sendungsnummer mit „Etikett erstellt“ aktiv, während der Karton noch in Indiana steht.

segments.src: Overnight the trailer runs to a sort hub — Memphis, Louisville, wherever the network routes it.
segments.tr: Über Nacht fährt der Trailer zu einem Sortierzentrum: Memphis, Louisville, wohin das Netz ihn leitet.

segments.src: Each scan there is a status message flowing back upstream, which is what refreshes the tracking page you check at breakfast.
segments.tr: Jeder Scan dort ist eine Statusmeldung, die stromaufwärts zurückfließt, und die die Sendungsverfolgungsseite aktualisiert, die Sie beim Frühstück prüfen.

segments.src: Two days later it's on your porch.
segments.tr: Zwei Tage später liegt es auf Ihrer Veranda.

segments.src: You saw six tracking updates.
segments.tr: Sie haben sechs Sendungsverfolgungs-Updates gesehen.

segments.src: The systems exchanged roughly fifty messages, and any one of them going quiet is what turns "out for delivery" into a support ticket.
segments.tr: Die Systeme haben rund fünfzig Nachrichten ausgetauscht, und wenn eine davon ausbleibt, wird aus „Auslieferung heute“ ein Support-Ticket.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Zusammenfassung in drei Zeilen

segments.src: 1. Logistics runs on three cooperating systems: ERP (the order and the books), WMS (inside the warehouse), TMS (freight and carriers).
segments.tr: 1. Die Logistik läuft auf drei zusammenarbeitenden Systemen: ERP (Auftrag und Buchhaltung), WMS (im Lager), TMS (Fracht und Frachtführer).

segments.src: 2. They talk through EDI transaction sets or APIs, and the integration seams — not the individual systems — are where most projects fail.
segments.tr: 2. Sie kommunizieren über EDI-Transaktionssätze oder APIs, und die Integrationsschnittstellen, nicht die einzelnen Systeme, sind der Ort, an dem die meisten Projekte scheitern.

segments.src: 3. Barcodes and RFID are the data-capture layer; without accurate scans, every system downstream is confidently wrong.
segments.tr: 3. Barcodes und RFID bilden die Datenerfassungsschicht; ohne genaue Scans liegt jedes nachgelagerte System selbstbewusst falsch.

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Heutige Begriffe

segments.src: - **WMS (Warehouse Management System):** Software that directs work inside the warehouse — receiving, putaway, slotting, picking, packing, and cycle counting.
segments.tr: - **WMS (Warehouse Management System):** Software, die die Arbeit innerhalb des Lagers steuert: Wareneingang, Einlagerung, Lagerplatzoptimierung, Kommissionierung, Verpackung und Zyklusinventur.

segments.src: - **TMS (Transportation Management System):** Software that selects carriers and modes, consolidates and tenders loads, tracks freight, and audits carrier invoices.
segments.tr: - **TMS (Transportation Management System):** Software, die Frachtführer und Verkehrsträger auswählt, Ladungen bündelt und übergibt, Sendungen verfolgt und Frachtrechnungen prüft.

segments.src: - **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning):** The company-wide system of record for orders, purchasing, item master data, and finance — the source WMS and TMS take direction from.
segments.tr: - **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning):** Das unternehmensweite führende System für Aufträge, Einkauf, Artikelstammdaten und Finanzen, von dem WMS und TMS ihre Anweisungen erhalten.

segments.src: - **EDI (Electronic Data Interchange):** Standardized business documents exchanged machine-to-machine (e.g., 856 advance ship notice, 214 shipment status), still the backbone of U.S. retail supply chains.
segments.tr: - **EDI (Electronic Data Interchange):** Standardisierte Geschäftsdokumente, die maschinell ausgetauscht werden (z. B. 856 Vorab-Versandanzeige, 214 Sendungsstatus), nach wie vor das Rückgrat der US-Einzelhandels-Lieferketten.

segments.src: - **SSCC / license plate:** An 18-digit serial number in a GS1-128 barcode on a pallet or carton, letting one scan retrieve everything that unit contains.
segments.tr: - **SSCC / Kennzeichen:** Eine 18-stellige Seriennummer in einem GS1-128-Barcode auf einer Palette oder einem Karton, mit der ein einziger Scan alles abruft, was diese Einheit enthält.

segments.src: *Answers: **1 — B.** The WMS owns everything inside the four walls, including slotting and pick-path logic; the ERP holds the order, not the bin location.
segments.tr: *Lösungen: **1 — B.** Das WMS ist für alles innerhalb der vier Wände zuständig, einschließlich Lagerplatzoptimierung und Pfadlogik für die Kommissionierung; das ERP enthält den Auftrag, nicht den Lagerplatz.

segments.src: **2 — False.** RFID tags cost more than a printed barcode; the real advantage is bulk, no-line-of-sight reading — hundreds of tags at once, through packaging.
segments.tr: **2 — Falsch.** RFID-Etiketten kosten mehr als ein gedruckter Barcode; der eigentliche Vorteil liegt im Massen-Lesen ohne Sichtverbindung: Hunderte Etiketten gleichzeitig, durch die Verpackung hindurch.

segments.src: **3 — B.** Freight audit and pay is a core TMS function, and recovering billing errors is often how a TMS pays for itself.*
segments.tr: **3 — B.** Frachtprüfung und Zahlung sind eine Kernfunktion des TMS, und das Zurückholen von Abrechnungsfehlern ist oft der Weg, wie sich ein TMS selbst bezahlt.*

vi.title: [Logistics 101 #13] Gói hàng của bạn di chuyển hai lần. Dữ liệu của nó di chuyển năm mươi lần.

segments.src: > Warehouses and trucks move boxes, but software decides which box, which truck, and when — and that software is really three systems (WMS, TMS, ERP) stitched together by scans.
segments.tr: > Kho hàng và xe tải di chuyển thùng hàng, nhưng phần mềm quyết định thùng nào, xe nào và khi nào — và phần mềm đó thực chất là ba hệ thống (WMS, TMS, ERP) được nối với nhau bằng các lần quét mã.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Khái niệm hôm nay

segments.src: Picture the last thing you ordered online.
segments.tr: Hãy nghĩ đến món đồ cuối cùng bạn đặt mua trực tuyến.

segments.src: Physically, it made maybe four moves: shelf to tote, tote to box, box to trailer, trailer to your porch.
segments.tr: Về mặt vật lý, nó có lẽ đã trải qua khoảng bốn lần di chuyển: từ kệ sang giỏ, từ giỏ sang thùng, từ thùng sang thùng xe rơ-moóc, từ rơ-moóc đến trước hiên nhà bạn.

segments.src: Digitally, it triggered dozens of transactions — an order record, an inventory allocation, a pick task, a carton label, a rate quote, a load tender, six or seven tracking scans, an invoice.
segments.tr: Về mặt số liệu, nó đã kích hoạt hàng chục giao dịch — một bản ghi đơn hàng, một phân bổ tồn kho, một nhiệm vụ lấy hàng, một nhãn thùng, một báo giá cước, một yêu cầu đặt xe, sáu bảy lần quét theo dõi, và một hóa đơn.

segments.src: That digital layer is the **logistics information system**, and in most companies it's not one product.
segments.tr: Lớp số liệu đó chính là **hệ thống thông tin logistics**, và ở hầu hết các công ty, nó không phải là một sản phẩm duy nhất.

segments.src: It's three, each with its own job:
segments.tr: Mà là ba sản phẩm, mỗi cái có nhiệm vụ riêng:

segments.src: **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning)** is the system of record — the company's books.
segments.tr: **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning — Hoạch định nguồn lực doanh nghiệp)** là hệ thống ghi nhận chính thức — sổ sách của công ty.

segments.src: It holds the customer order, the purchase order, the item master, the price, the general ledger.
segments.tr: Nó lưu đơn đặt hàng của khách, đơn mua hàng, danh mục mặt hàng, giá bán, sổ cái.

segments.src: SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics.
segments.tr: SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics.

segments.src: The ERP knows *what* was promised to whom, but it has almost no idea where any physical carton is sitting right now.
segments.tr: ERP biết *đã hứa gì với ai*, nhưng hầu như không biết bất kỳ thùng hàng vật lý nào đang ở đâu ngay lúc này.

segments.src: **WMS (Warehouse Management System)** runs everything inside the four walls.
segments.tr: **WMS (Warehouse Management System — Hệ thống quản lý kho)** vận hành mọi thứ bên trong bốn bức tường.

segments.src: It directs receiving, decides where to putaway a pallet (slotting), generates pick tasks in an efficient walk path, controls packing and cartonization, manages cycle counts, and produces the shipping label.
segments.tr: Nó điều phối việc nhận hàng, quyết định vị trí cất pallet (slotting), tạo nhiệm vụ lấy hàng theo lộ trình đi bộ hiệu quả, kiểm soát đóng gói và đóng thùng, quản lý kiểm kê chu kỳ, và in nhãn vận chuyển.

segments.src: Manhattan Associates, Blue Yonder, Körber.
segments.tr: Manhattan Associates, Blue Yonder, Körber.

segments.src: The WMS is the only system that truly knows that SKU 44821 is in aisle 12, bin B, quantity 63.
segments.tr: WMS là hệ thống duy nhất thực sự biết SKU 44821 đang nằm ở lối 12, ngăn B, số lượng 63.

segments.src: **TMS (Transportation Management System)** takes over once freight leaves the dock — and often before.
segments.tr: **TMS (Transportation Management System — Hệ thống quản lý vận tải)** tiếp quản khi hàng rời khỏi bến xếp dỡ — và thường còn sớm hơn thế.

segments.src: It rates and compares carriers, picks the mode (parcel, LTL, truckload, intermodal), consolidates small orders into one load, tenders that load to a carrier, tracks it, and audits the freight bill against the contracted rate.
segments.tr: Nó so sánh và đánh giá các hãng vận chuyển, chọn phương thức (bưu kiện, LTL, xe tải nguyên chuyến, đa phương thức), gom các đơn hàng nhỏ thành một chuyến, giao chuyến đó cho hãng vận chuyển, theo dõi, và đối chiếu hóa đơn cước với mức giá đã ký hợp đồng.

segments.src: Overpaying carriers is shockingly common without one; freight audit alone often pays for the software.
segments.tr: Việc trả quá nhiều tiền cho hãng vận chuyển phổ biến đến mức đáng sốc khi không có hệ thống này; riêng việc kiểm toán cước vận tải thường đã đủ để trả tiền cho phần mềm.

segments.src: The hard part isn't any single system.
segments.tr: Phần khó không nằm ở bất kỳ hệ thống đơn lẻ nào.

segments.src: It's **the seams**.
segments.tr: Mà nằm ở **các mối nối**.

segments.src: In the U.S., those seams are usually crossed one of two ways: **EDI**, the decades-old transaction-set standard (a 940 tells the warehouse to ship, a 945 confirms it shipped, a 204 tenders a load to a trucker, a 214 sends status updates back, an 856 is the advance ship notice that tells the retailer what's on the truck), or modern **APIs**, which do the same thing in near real time.
segments.tr: Tại Mỹ, các mối nối này thường được kết nối theo một trong hai cách: **EDI**, chuẩn tiêu chuẩn giao dịch đã tồn tại hàng thập kỷ (một bản 940 yêu cầu kho xuất hàng, bản 945 xác nhận đã xuất, bản 204 giao chuyến cho tài xế, bản 214 gửi cập nhật trạng thái ngược lại, và bản 856 là thông báo giao hàng trước (ASN) cho nhà bán lẻ biết những gì có trên xe), hoặc **API** hiện đại, thực hiện cùng việc đó gần như theo thời gian thực.

segments.src: A retail vendor who mis-formats an 856 gets a chargeback, not an email.
segments.tr: Một nhà cung cấp bán lẻ định dạng sai bản 856 sẽ bị hoàn trừ tiền, chứ không chỉ nhận một email.

segments.src: And all of it runs on one humble input: **the scan**.
segments.tr: Và tất cả đều chạy trên một đầu vào khiêm tốn: **lần quét mã**.

segments.src: Order (ERP) -> allocate -> pick & pack (WMS) -> label -> tender (TMS)
segments.tr: Order (ERP) -> allocate -> pick & pack (WMS) -> label -> tender (TMS)

segments.src: -> carrier scans -> status back to ERP -> invoice -> freight audit
segments.tr: -> carrier scans -> status back to ERP -> invoice -> freight audit

segments.src: **Barcodes** are the workhorse.
segments.tr: **Mã vạch** là công cụ chủ lực.

segments.src: A UPC identifies the product; a GS1-128 label on a pallet carries an SSCC — an 18-digit serial number that acts as a "license plate" so one scan pulls up the entire contents of that pallet.
segments.tr: Mã UPC nhận diện sản phẩm; nhãn GS1-128 trên pallet mang một SSCC — số sê-ri 18 chữ số đóng vai trò như “biển số xe” để một lần quét có thể hiển thị toàn bộ nội dung của pallet đó.

segments.src: Barcodes are effectively free to print, but they need line of sight and one read at a time.
segments.tr: Mã vạch hầu như không tốn chi phí in, nhưng cần đường nhìn thẳng và chỉ đọc được từng cái một.

segments.src: **RFID** (in retail supply chains, usually passive UHF "RAIN" RFID) flips that.
segments.tr: **RFID** (trong chuỗi cung ứng bán lẻ thường là RFID UHF thụ động “RAIN”) thì ngược lại.

segments.tr: Đầu đọc có thể nhận hàng trăm thẻ cùng lúc, xuyên qua thùng carton, mà không cần ai phải hướng về phía nào.
